name: Changjiang Publishing & Media Co.,Ltd
summary: Changjiang Publishing & Media Co.,Ltd operates as a publishing company in China. The company engages in the publication, distribution, printing and material trade of books, periodicals, newspapers, audiovisual products, and electronic publications. It also offers publication and distribution of textbooks, teaching aids, general books, and audio-visual products, as well as engages in the procurement and sale of paper, equipment and other materials and products; and printing and packaging of various books and periodicals.
